Name: I'm Cafe
Author: podopo11
Description:
[b][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]Description[/font][/size][/b]

You plant every fruit tree because, of course, you do. Then harvest season arrives, your chests fill up, and you realize you’re not entirely sure what to do with all that fruit. That’s why I made I'm Cafe—to turn those slightly neglected harvests into cakes, smoothies, ades, bingsu, and plenty of cozy café treats!

[color=#D4D4D8]Add a cozy café menu to Pelican Town! I'm Cafe is a Content Patcher content pack that adds 34 new ingredients, desserts, baked goods, and drinks to Stardew Valley. Discover new recipes by leveling up your skills, receiving letters, experiencing NPC events, and completing a special order. Use your homemade ingredients to prepare colorful fruit desserts, refreshing iced drinks, and rich coffee beverages. The mod supports both English and Korean, with optional recipe compatibility for Stardew Valley Expanded. [/color]


[b][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]INSTALLATION[/font][/size][/b]

 1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
 2. Download I'm Cafe and extract the archive.
 3. Place the [CP] I'm Cafe folder directly inside your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
 4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

 When updating the mod, delete the existing [CP] I'm Cafe folder before installing the new version. It is recommended that you do not overwrite or merge the two folders.


[size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Main features[/b][/font][/size]

• 34 new café ingredients, desserts, baked goods, and drinks 
• 31 new cooking recipes • Bottled Water and Carbonated Water sold at Pierre's General Store 
• An animated Ice Maker that turns one Bottled Water into 15 Ice 
• Homemade Condensed Milk, Fresh Cream, and Caramel Sauce 
• Fruit cakes, smoothies, ades, bingsu, bagels, pudding, and coffee drinks 
• Coffee buffs with unique names and icons 
• New events featuring Maru and Evelyn 
• A summer Special Order from Gus 
• Expanded villager gift tastes and custom dialogue 
• Additional gift reactions and recipe compatibility when Stardew Valley Expanded is installed 
• English and Korean localization • Built entirely with Content Patcher, with no custom C# code


[b][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]Requirements[/font][/size][/b]

[color=#D4D4D8]Required: [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Stardew Valley 1.6.15 [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• SMAPI [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Content Patcher [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Optional: [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Stardew Valley Expanded [/color]

Stardew Valley Expanded is not required. When it is installed, supported baking recipes use Butter from SVE, while ades use Birch Syrup instead of Sugar.


[b][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]COMPATIBILITY AND NOTES[/font][/size][/b] 

• Designed for Stardew Valley 1.6.15 
• Compatible with both vanilla Stardew Valley and Stardew Valley Expanded 
• Due to a limitation in the vanilla cooking recipe system, the Jelly used in Blueberry Cheesecake can be any flavor 
• When reporting an issue, please include your SMAPI log and a description of what happened

Community translations are welcome. If you would like to translate this mod into another language, you may upload your own translation patch or contact me about adding the translation file to this mod.

[spoiler][b]RECIPE UNLOCK HINTS [/b]

The following section contains minor progression spoilers! 


Reach 2 hearts with Maru, then enter the Carpenter’s Shop between 1:20 PM and 4:00 PM on any day in summer. After watching the event, you’ll learn the Ice Maker crafting recipe!

• Farming Level 3 — Condensed Milk and Fresh Cream 
• Foraging Level 4 — Caramel Sauce • Maru — Visit the Carpenter's Shop during summer with at least 2 hearts 
• Evelyn — Experience her recipe book event with at least 6 hearts 
• Harvey — Reach at least 2 hearts and check your mail 
• Gus — Complete the Special Order that begins during summer 
• Tropical Menu — Purchase the recipes from the Stardrop Saloon after Leo moves to Stardew Valley[/spoiler]
